HIGH: a sandbox.excludedCommands glob no longer exempts an entire compound Bash command when only one part matched - every part must now match (2.1.278)

HIGH: subagent results now reach the main agent under a header marking them as subagent output, with the result indented, so text in a subagent's result cannot pass as the session's own instructions (2.1.278); workflow scripts' computed agent() prompts on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry are likewise framed as script-authored text (2.1.278)
HIGH: plugins installed from an npm source are now fetched with npm pack --ignore-scripts and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run (2.1.276)

HIGH: one malformed strictKnownMarketplaces or blockedMarketplaces entry was silently disabling the whole enterprise marketplace policy - fixed (2.1.278)

Project skills from the main repository were not loading in --worktree sessions when .claude/skills is untracked - fixed (2.1.278); /plugin Installed and /skills crashed on a skill named like a built-in Object property such as constructor or toString - fixed (2.1.278)

claude.ai account skills and plugins now sync to terminal sessions signed in with that account; opt out with syncClaudeAiSkills: false / syncClaudeAiPlugins: false (2.1.275). --forward-subagent-text no longer drops messages of subagents spawned by a context: fork skill (2.1.275)

Plugin bookkeeping: official-marketplace plugins were recorded without their commit in installed_plugins.json and kept the old commit after a pinned-commit update - fixed (2.1.278); reinstalling a version another session was using no longer breaks the installed copy (2.1.278); plugin/marketplace clones leave Git LFS files as pointers (2.1.274); /plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source> added (2.1.275)

Sandbox/shell: $TMPDIR expanded empty in Bash commands running outside the sandbox while sandboxing is enabled - fixed (2.1.278); sandboxed Bash on Linux reported exit code 0 for failed commands under zsh - fixed (2.1.276); sandboxed commands could not write to project directories named hooks/ or config/ - fixed (2.1.276)

CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS bounds how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (0 = don't wait) (2.1.274); Streamable HTTP MCP tool calls now honor a per-server timeout longer than ~5 minutes; a 403 insufficient_scope now names the missing permissions instead of reporting an expired sign-in (2.1.274)

/code-review now uses leaner inline review prompts for every model with no tuned settings of its own instead of spawning many review subagents (2.1.274); /ultrareview refuses in non-interactive sessions when the repository has no base branch or shared history (2.1.278)

Subagents with model: "opus" on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry left the session's model when its id has no recognizable family - fixed (2.1.274); resumed subagents and teammates re-rendered their MCP tool definitions, breaking prompt caching - fixed (2.1.278); safety checks improved before removing an agent worktree containing submodule checkouts (2.1.274)

2.1.276 is a single-line regression fix for ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL proxies; the remaining bulk of the window is VS Code, Claude Tag, Claude Code on the web, TUI rendering and crash fixes with no rule impact
